content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Transactions ## slug: transactions ## seoTitle: Transactions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Introduction The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object is used to authorize, capture, and refund charges, as well as serve other functions (see below). There are four record types on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object: **"Charge" (formerly called "Stripe"):** Charging a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, refunding a charge, or logging a "Non-Gateway" {{variable.Object_Transaction}} (monies that transferred outside of {{variable.Product_Stripe}} but you want to keep track of in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}, such as a wire transfer). **"Payouts":** Auto-created by {{variable.Product_Stripe}} webhooks for stand-alone accounts (ordinary/common accounts). These can be manually created and processed if you're using {{variable.Feature_StripeConnect}} to initiate the "paying out" of funds from a {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account to an External Account (bank account or debit card). **"Transfer" (Stripe Connect only):** Moves funds between {{variable.Product_Stripe}} accounts. **"Adjustment":** This {{variable.Object_Transaction}} type is used by {{variable.Product_Stripe}} to send money to your account or debit your account (such as with a dispute's fee). ![H_01_12_Intro](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_Intro.png){height="" width=""} {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s can relate to any object defined in the Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} {{variable.Feature_PaymentsSetupWizard}}. A lookup relationship is automatically created between the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object and the parent object(s) you select. {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s can also process in [any currency that Stripe supports](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies){target="_blank"}. Each currency has a record in [Custom Metadata](/v1/docs/custom-metadata) for the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} to reference based on the value from the {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} field. ## Process Flow With all four record types, the most important part of {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s is understanding the process flow. There are two fields on this object that provide the most information, {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}}. These fields have picklist options (the majority of them are set automatically) that provide insight into what your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s have done. | **{{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}}** | **{{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}}** | **Meaning** | | --- | --- | --- | | "Open" | "null" | A {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} but is not processed to any gateways yet. | | "Completed" | "Authorized" | The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is authorized. | | "Completed" | "Captured" | The payment is successfully captured. | | "Completed" | "Uncaptured" | An authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is released. | | "Completed" | "Refunded" | The charged {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is refunded. | | "Completed" | "Partially Refunded" | The charged {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is partially refunded. | | "Failed" | "null" | The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} failed to capture. The {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorCode}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorMessage}} will be captured. | | "Pending" | "null" | The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has a related ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} in a waiting period for 3-4 days. Or if your platform's account/connected account balance is sufficiently negative, then the refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is set to "Pending" status. | | "Needs Review" | "null" | The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is invalid for some reason; the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorMessage}} will display the issue and the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ToFix}} field will display the possible solution. | | "Canceled" | "null" | Mainly used in [Payment Schedules](/v1/docs/payment-schedules), when a schedule is canceled and the underlying unprocessed/pending {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are also canceled. | ### Transaction Status **"Open" (set automatically):** A {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that has not yet been processed or authorized. **"Process" (set automatically):** This is a technical field that you will only see after capturing or authorizing a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. Once you refresh your page, it will automatically change to the next status. **"Pending" (set automatically):** This status is only shown when a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has a related ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and is within the 3-4 day waiting period, or if your platform's account/connected account balance is sufficiently negative. Then the refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is set to a status of "Pending". *ACH {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s can take up to four days before reaching a "Completed" or "Failed" status.* **"Pending Payment Intent":** This status my indicate that you need to enable [Strong Customer Authentication or SCA](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/sca){target=`_blank`}. Review the Transaction in Stripe to confirm the specific issue. **"Completed" (set automatically):** When the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is fully completed. Reference the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} as the result of the completed {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. **"On-Hold" (set manually):** A {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that's set to auto-process but is currently on hold. This will remove the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} from the daily auto capture job. Change the status back to "Open" when it should automatically process. *Manually add the picklist value to the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} field in the "Charge" {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}}.* **"Canceled" (set manually):** If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was created by mistake or needs to be canceled for any reason while still in the "Open" status, it can be manually switched to "Canceled". *{{variable.Object_Transaction}}s with a status other than "Open" cannot be switched to "Canceled" unless you disable the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} validations in [Custom Settings](/v1/docs/custom-settings).* **"Needs Review" (set automatically):** This status is shown when an error within {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} impacted the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} from completing successfully. *View the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorMessage}} field or [Blackthorn Logs ](/v1/docs/blackthorn-logs) for additional information. The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} may need to be set back to "Open" and recaptured if it was not sent to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}.* **"Failed" (set automatically):** The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} tried to complete but failed. The reason why it failed to complete may be located in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ToFix}} field or a {{variable.Product_Stripe}} error message populated. ### Payment Status The {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} field is automatically populated when the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed". **"Authorized":** This status means the amount of the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has been guaranteed by the card issuer and the amount is held for up to 7 days unless it's released early. **"Captured":** The full {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} was captured and the funds were taken out from the associated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. **"Partially Captured":** The original {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} was authorized, but then a lesser amount was captured. **"Refunded":** The original {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} was fully refunded back to the associated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. **"Partially Refunded":** Part of the original {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} was refunded back to the associated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. **"Disputed":** The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was captured but is now disputed by your customer. It will remain in this status until the {{variable.Object_Dispute}} has been won or lost. See more about [{{variable.Object_Dispute}}s](/v1/docs/disputes). *The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will automatically update to this status if [webhooks](/v1/docs/webhooks) are enabled.* **"Uncaptured":** If an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has not been captured in 7 days or refunded, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will automatically update to this status if webhooks are enabled. ## Charge Transaction Record Type When creating a charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record, there are several fields that automatically update: {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainedAmou}}: When a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has been successfully completed, this field's amount is the same as the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}. If any refunds are made against this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainedAmou}} will show the remaining amount. {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}}: "Normal" is the default value, but if there is a full refund or a negative balance, this type will automatically update to "Refund". {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayLink}}: If you purchased this paid add-on, this is the link you can send out to customers for capturing the payment. For additional information, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/introduction-1). {{variable.Field_Transaction_ToFix}}: This field automatically displays a message about the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} if it was not captured correctly. See the table below for more information. | Criteria | To Fix (Output) | | --- | --- | | {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked and {{variable.Field_Transaction_DueDate}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_DateProcess}} is blank | If {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked, a {{variable.Field_Transaction_DueDate}} or {{variable.Field_Transaction_DateProcess}} is needed to automatically capture this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. | | {{variable.Field_Transaction_InvalidPM}} is checked | The related {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is not valid to capture this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. | | {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} is blank and {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" |If {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked, a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is needed to automatically capture this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. | | {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked and {{variable.Field_Transaction_ConnectAcct}} is blank and {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Transfer" | If {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked, a {{variable.Object_ConnectedAccount}} is needed to automatically process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. | | {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked and {{variable.Field_Transaction_ConnectAcct}} is blank and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayoutMethod}} is blank and {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Payout" | If {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} is checked, a {{variable.Object_ConnectedAccount}} / {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is needed to automatically process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. | {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}}: This field is set automatically under a few scenarios. If the field is blank and a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is related, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} will automatically set to the value of the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGateway}} after the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} processes. If the field is blank and a {{variable.Product_PayLink}} is sent to your customer, the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} will automatically be set to your org's default {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} after the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} is set to "Completed." Alternatively, you can set the value of the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} prior to processing (if there is no related {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}) to 'tell' {{variable.Product_PayLink}} which {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} to process through. {{variable.Field_Transaction_Contact}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}}: If both of these fields are null and the related {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} and {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} have a value, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_Contact}} will be updated with those values. {{variable.Field_Transaction_PMBilliEmail}}: Will be set automatically from the related {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} when a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is added to the record and saved. The “Send Blackthorn | Payment Receipt” flow launches the Payments Receipt Email from the flow in the Payments package. The email receipt will be sent when the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is completed/captured and will contain the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s {{variable.Field_Transaction_Description}} in a merge field. Use the steps below to test the flow. 1. Process a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with the following values: * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = “Normal” * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = “Completed” * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = “Capture” * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PMBilliEmail}} = the email address where you would like to receive the test 2. The email will be sent, and the email receipt will contain the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s {{variable.Field_Transaction_Description}}. {{variable.Field_Transaction_OgTranRefund}}: If this is a refund type {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, this field will automatically populate a lookup to the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. {{variable.Field_Transaction_OgTranReatte}}: If this is the reattempted {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, this field will automatically populate a lookup to the original "Failed" {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. {{variable.Field_Transaction_AvailableOn}}: This field provides the date that this amount is available in your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account. {{variable.Field_Transaction_BalanceStatu}}: This field lets you know if the amount is part of your Pending or Available balance in {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. ## Processing Transactions Below are instructions for processing each type of {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. :::(Info) (Webhooks) In some cases like ACH processing you may need to enable webhooks so statuses can be asynchronously updated. Use our [webhook documentation](/v1/docs/webhooks) to complete the setup. ::: ### Authorized Transaction ![Authorizing a Transaction](https://youtu.be/OF0uF8TnUeQ){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. * **Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click Transactions.* * **Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click Transactions.* 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge". 4. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 5. Fill in the following required fields: * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}: The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} amount. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}}: The currency to process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}}: The {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} used to process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.*The {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} must be valid to authorize a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.* 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}. * ***Lightning:** Click the down arrow (top right corner) > Click {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}.* * ***Classic:** Click the {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}} button at the top.* If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was successful, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed" and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Authorized". If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is not captured within 7 days, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Uncaptured" when webhooks are enabled.*The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} can no longer be captured and you will need to clone this {{variable.Object_Transaction}} or create a new one.* If you'd like to capture or partially capture the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} of the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, click the {{variable.Button_Capture}} button to charge the full {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} or update the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} to a lesser amount then click {{variable.Button_Capture}} (see below for more information). ### Captured Transaction ![Capturing a Transaction](https://youtu.be/NQvyNYdpQj8){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. * ***Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click Transactions.* * ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click Transactions.* 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge". 4. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 5. Fill in the following required fields: * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}: The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} amount. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}}: The currency to process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}}: The {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} used to process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.*The {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} must be valid to capture a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.* 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click {{variable.Button_Capture}}. * ***Lightning:** Click the down arrow (top right corner) > Click {{variable.Button_Capture}}.* * ***Classic:** Click {{variable.Button_Capture}} at the top.* If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was successful, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed" and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Captured". ### Partially Captured Transaction ![Partially Capturing an Authorized Transaction](https://youtu.be/CHuM0_0Q12Y){height="480" width="640"} Once a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has successfully authorized, and you decide to capture less than the original amount, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} updates to "Partially Captured." 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. * ***Lightning:** Click the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click Transactions.* * ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click Transactions.* 2. Select an existing {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Authorized. 3. Update the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field to a lesser amount. 4. Fill in the following required fields: * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}}: The currency to process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}}: The {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} used to process this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.*The {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} must be valid to capture a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.* 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Capture}}. * ***Lightning:** Click the down arrow (top right corner) > Click {{variable.Button_Capture}}.* * ***Classic:** Click {{variable.Button_Capture}} at the top.* If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was successful, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed" and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Partially Captured". ### Releasing Authorized Transactions The {{variable.Field_Transaction_UncaptMethod}} field shows if an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was released (refunded) before the 7 days. * **"Manual":** This means the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was manually released from the user. * **"Automatic":** This means the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was automatically released by {{variable.Product_Stripe}} after 7 days. *When you need to release an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} before 7 days.* 1. Navigate to the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} 2. Click {{variable.Button_Refund}}. The authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has been released in {{variable.Product_Stripe}} and the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} updates to "Refunded." This will not create a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, it will update the existing {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. *Follow the process above to release a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}.* :::(Warning) (In Payments version 4.54 and later...) When you release an authorized transaction by clicking the Refund button, there are no refund transaction created and the Payment Status updates to "Uncaptured". ::: ### Non-Gateway Transaction Recording a Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is similar to creating a charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with the exception that a Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is not subject to the validations and processes that a charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is subject to. However, you can [refund and partially refund](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/transactions#refundedpartially-refunded-transaction) Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s; you can use the {{variable.Button_Refund}} / {{variable.Button_PartialRefund}} buttons and checkboxes the same way you'd use it with normal {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. * ***Lightning:** Click the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click Transactions.* * ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click Transactions.* 3. Select {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge". 4. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 5. Fill in the following required fields: * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}: The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} amount. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}}: The currency of this {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_NonGateway}}: Checking this field indicates the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is a "Non-Gateway Transaction" and you can manually set any of the fields. IE Transaction for cash or a mailed-in check.*Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are not processed or captured like charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s.* 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![H_01_12_non gateway transaction](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_non%20gateway%20transaction.png){height="" width=""} ### Failed Transactions {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s that fail to process, such as for card declines, cannot be retried. The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} must be cloned then reattempted. The app is built this way because {{variable.Product_Stripe}} maintains IDs, even for failed {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. #### Spreedly If a {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} {{variable.Object_Transaction}} fails, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will contain the following information describing the reason for the failure. * If the response includes an error code, it will be stored in the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorCode}} field. * The {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s token will be stored in the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s {{variable.Field_Transac_SpreedlTranToken}} field. * The date the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was processed will be stored in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ProcessedDat}} field. #### Stripe When a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with an ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} using a Stripe gateway fails, a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created. Its {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} is set to “Refund,” {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} is set to “Failed,” {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} field is blank, and the Stripe Fee related to the failure is recorded. ### Deleting Transactions By default, once a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has any {{variable.Product_Stripe}} fields populated (such as the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorMessage}} or {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}}), you will not be able to delete it. If you do need to delete a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, you can disable the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} validations in [custom settings](/v1/docs/custom-settings). This is done because Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} is built to be a mirror of your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} database. ## Refund Transactions {{snippet.PAY_RefundAuthNetTransactions}} There are 2 paths to create a refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. * {{variable.Button_Refund}} / {{variable.Button_PartialRefund}} buttons on a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record Creates a refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} for either the exact amount or an amount selected by the user. * {{variable.Button_PTAdmin_ProSchRefundTra}} button on [Blackthorn | Payments Admin – Batch Jobs](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/blackthorn-payments-admin#batch-jobs){target="_blank"} tab runs the job at the exact moment the button is pushed. It will only process {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s that meet the specific criteria for manual refunds. ### Refunded/Partially Refunded Transaction :::(Warning) (Transactionn Page Layout Update) The {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} field is not included on the Charge Transaction Layout page layout by default. To add the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} field, go to Setup > Object Manager > Transaction > Page Layout > Charge Transaction Layout. ::: To refund a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in full, click the {{variable.Button_Refund}} button. To partially refund a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, click on the {{variable.Button_PartialRefund}} button, enter the amount to be partially refunded and click {{variable.Button_Refund}}. Both refunds and partial refunds will create {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s related to the original, parent {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. The {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainedAmou}} field captures the amount of the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} left after all refund(s). *Ex. If the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} = "100" and two partial refunds of 35 each (70 total) were processed, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainedAmou}} field will be "30".* NOTE: The {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} field of a refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is set on record creation. For example, if the refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created from a {{variable.Object_WebhookEvent}}, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} will specify “Webhook.” Or if the refund is processed from {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} field will specify “Salesforce UI.” You can also fully refund or partially refund Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s (see: Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s). ![Partially Refunding a Transaction](https://youtu.be/4bGwOGydFvg){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. * ***Lightning:** Click the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click Transactions.* * ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) | Click on Transactions.* 2. Select an existing "Captured", "Partially Captured" or "Partially Refunded" {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 3. Click {{variable.Button_Refund}} or {{variable.Button_PartialRefund}}. 4. If performing a partial refund, enter the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Refund}}. If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was a full refund, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed" and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Refunded". If it was a partial refund, {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed" and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Partial Refund". ### Scheduled Refund Transactions Now To use the {{variable.Button_PTAdmin_ProSchRefundTra}} button to process a refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, complete the following steps. 1. Create a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 2. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge". 3. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 4. Enter the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} as “-x.xx”. 5. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = "Refund". 6. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_DueDate}} = a date that is less than or equal to today. 7. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} = “True”. 8. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Open". 9. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_OgTranRefund}} = the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 10. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} = {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} used for the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 11. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 12. Go to the {{variable.Tab_PT_BTPayAdmin}} tab. 13. On the Batch Jobs tab, click {{variable.Button_PTAdmin_ProSchRefundTra}}. 14. Go back to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that was just created. Once the job is complete, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} field will say “Completed”. ## Write-Off Transactions The new picklist value “Write Off” for the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} field is designed to deduct amounts from an Invoice while maintaining accurate records for financial reconciliation purposes. Users can define the process for creating write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s based on their unique requirements. Admins can implement this using tools such as Screen flows, Approval Processes, or other custom workflows to generate write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. Complete the following steps to create a new write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 1. From an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record page, click {{variable.button_new}} on the Transactions Related List. 2. Set the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} to "Charge". 3. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 4. Add an amount to write off in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field. 5. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = "Write Off". 6. Check the {{variable.Field_Transaction_NonGateway}} checkbox. This is required to create a write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. An error message will be displayed if this field is left blank. 7. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed". (This triggers the recalculation of {{variable.Object_Invoice}} totals). 8. Complete any other fields. (optional) 9. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} fields of {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}}, {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalancePaid}}, and {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalanceDue}} now reflect the new values. ## Auto-Process/Scheduled Transactions Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} has separate running scheduled batch jobs to process the daily charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, payouts, transfers and refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. Find details for each scheduled job [here](/v1/docs/scheduled-batch-jobs). *Need to configure reattempt logic for your scheduled {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s? If you would like a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}} automatically created and queued for auto-process when the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}} fails, click [here](/v1/docs/transaction-reattempt-logic).* ## Capture Multiple Transactions In List View ![Mass Capture Transactions in a List View](https://youtu.be/AyJ_mZvq7qc){height="480" width="640"} {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s can be manually processed in batch, up to 200 at a time through a {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} list view. To capture multiple {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s at one time: 1. Click the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object tab. 2. Click the "Scheduled for Auto-Process (Future)" packaged list view. 3. Use the checkboxes to select which records to process. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Capture}}. (If the {{variable.Button_Capture}} button is not available in your ListView, go to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object in Setup and add the button to your available List View buttons.) 5. On the next screen, verify which {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s to process. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Capture}}. ## Payout Transaction {{variable.Product_Stripe}} makes deposits (payouts) from your available account balance into your bank account. This account balance is comprised of different types of transactions (e.g., payments, refunds, etc.). :::(Info) () Stripe Payouts will now automatically relate to the Charges and Transfers included within them. This helps reconcile which Charges are included in which bank transfers that you receive. ::: ![H_01_12_payout transaction 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_payout%20transaction%201.png){height="" width=""} Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are created in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} via {{variable.Task_Webhook}} by {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. *They cannot be manually created in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}.* * Once a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Payout" has been created with a {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Paid", all charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are related to the Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} through the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Payout}} field on the Charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s via the daily charges batch job. :::(Info) () It is important that payouts relate to original charges, refunds, disputed refunds and transfers so that you can successfully prove and document that account balances are in agreement. ::: ![H_01_12_payout transaction 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_payout%20transaction%202.png){height="" width=""} In addition to relating a Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record to all original charges, refunds, and transfers we provide an [out-of-the-box report](/v1/docs/reports-1) on payouts and related {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. **Batch job process** * All Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s with a {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Payout", {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed" and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Paid". * The Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record then sets the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayoutProDat}} field with a timestamp when the record was processed so the batch job will not process it again. This batch job can also be triggered manually. Go to the {{variable.Tab_PT_BTPayAdmin}} tab, click the {{variable.Tab_BTPTAdmin_BatchJobs}} tab, and click {{variable.Button_PTAdmin_Bat_PayoutHisto}}. ## Adjustment Transaction This {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created via {{variable.Task_Webhook}} by {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. It should not be manually created. ## Parent Object Roll-up Fields There are roll-up fields that get automatically created on the parent object(s) you define in the Blackthorn | Payments Setup Wizard on the Relationship(s) Step. Each time you create or edit a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, an apex job called, "TransactionRollupToParentService" fires to update these balances. ![H_01_12_parent object rollup fields 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_parent%20object%20rollup%20fields%201.png){height="" width=""} ### Charge Transaction Fields Charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} roll-up fields are automatically placed on the parent object's page layout through the install wizard. *If you upgrade your org, these fields will need to be added manually to your page layout.* ![H_01_12_charge transaction fields](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_charge%20transaction%20fields.png){height="" width=""} The roll-up fields provide insight into all open, captured, refunded, retained, and non-gateway charges related to the parent object, like an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} record. 1. Navigate to a parent object record, i.e. an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} record. * ***Lightning:** Click the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click Opportunity.* * ***Classic:** Click "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click Opportunity.* 2. Scroll down to "Charge Totals". *This section provides the roll-up fields for a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge".* ## Checkboxes for Declarative Automation In addition to the {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}, {{variable.Button_Refund}}, and {{variable.Button_Capture}} buttons to process Charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, we have provided checkbox fields that mirror the button functions. These checkboxes allow you to process {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s automatically without the button. When Auto-Process runs, if {{variable.Field_Transaction_Authorize}} or {{variable.Field_Transaction_Refund}} are checked, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be authorized or refunded instead of being captured. Checking each checkbox will perform the same process as if you were clicking the {{variable.Button_Capture}} or {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}} button. These fields are on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object but are not on the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" {{variable.Object_Transaction}} page layout. ## Transaction Fees There are several fields that calculate certain fees for Charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. - {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayGatewaFee}}: This is the fee from your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} for successful {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. *The fee amount is based on your plan with your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}.* - {{variable.Field_Transaction_RefundPGFee}}: This is the refunded {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} fee amount if your {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was fully or partially refunded. *As of November 2017, {{variable.Product_Stripe}} stopped refunding fees for new customers.* - {{variable.Field_Transaction_NetPayGatFee}}: This is the sum of the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayGatewaFee}} minus the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RefundPGFee}}. - {{variable.Field_Transaction_ApplicatiFee}} ({{variable.Feature_StripeConnect}} only): The platform's application fee for direct charges from a {{variable.Feature_StripeConnect}} account. - {{variable.Field_Transaction_RefundAppFee}} ({{variable.Feature_StripeConnect}} only): This is the refunded application fee amount if your {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was fully or partially refunded. - {{variable.Field_Transaction_NetAppicaFee}}({{variable.Feature_StripeConnect}} only): This is the sum of the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ApplicatiFee}} minus the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RefundAppFee}}. - {{variable.Field_Transaction_NetAmount}}: This is the amount you receive after subtracting {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayGatewaFee}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_ApplicatiFee}} fees. - {{variable.Field_Transaction_RetainNetAmt}}: This is the amount you receive after subtracting {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayGatewaFee}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_ApplicatiFee}} fees and any refunds. *This amount may be negative if you performed a full refund and the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} fees were not refunded.* ![H_01_12_transaction fees](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_transaction%20fees.png){height="" width=""} ### Currency Conversion with Stripe When processing {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s in a different currency than your bank account settles in {{variable.Product_Stripe}}, you will see the exchange rate and converted amount populate on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} records in dedicated fields. There are two fields available to add to your page layout or include in reports * {{variable.Field_Transaction_ExchangeRate}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurConPayAmt}} #### Exchange Rate example: 1. My {{variable.Product_Stripe}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} is in USD. 2. My {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is in CAD. 3. The {{variable.Field_Transaction_ExchangeRate}} will populate with "0.74". * 0.74 is the current value of CAD to USD. #### Currency Conversion Payout Amount example: 1. My {{variable.Product_Stripe}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} is in USD. 2. My {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is in CAD. 3. I charge a customer CAD 100. 4. The {{variable.Field_Transaction_ExchangeRate}} will populate with "0.74". 5. I will receive "$74" in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurConPayAmt}} field. ## Roll-up/Roll-down Features ### Payment Method When a {{variable.Object_Contact}}'s or {{variable.Object_Account}}'s default {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} (a lookup field on each respective object) is updated, all "Open" {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s' {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s related to that customer will update automatically.
